target_customer: Businesses and individual investors who buy, sell or rent commercial real estate in India
problem: Indian commercial real estate is fragmented and opaque, so transactions are slow and hard to price without data.
business_model: Transaction platform with brokerage or fee on commercial real estate deals, later fractional ownership investing

founders.name: Jayant Panwar
founders.background_notes: YC page bio lists AudaceLabs and AutoChain; education from the Inc42 article that calls the founders BITS Pilani graduates.

founders.name: Kenish Shah
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in Inc42 July 2022 article.

founders.name: Somil Mathur
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder in Inc42 July 2022 article and listed on the YC page; a directory calls him CTO (unverified).

technical_complexity.rationale: A listings and transaction platform with data layers; standard web engineering, with most difficulty in operations and sourcing inventory.

defensibility.rationale: Inventory and deal data could build over time, but brokers and listing portals could replicate the front end.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found on incumbent moves against it.

market_need_then: The YC description cites a highly fragmented and non-transparent Indian commercial real estate market; no dated demand figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Operates on propreturns.com; no history found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found; coverage focuses on funding.

outcome_analysis: PropReturns raised about 1.2 million dollars after YC in late 2021 and a strategic angel round in July 2022 backed by Indian operators. The dataset marks it Inactive but search found no shutdown report, and later profiles describe a fractional ownership model, so the cause of inactivity is not public.
notes: Company site returned HTTP 402 so it could not be read. YC page status is Inactive but one search summary described it as active; the conflict is unresolved. Competitor lists found were current aggregator pages with no dated source near 2021, so the list is empty. Aggregator geo.sig.ai claims 1.32M with LetsVenture, unverified. The December 2021 date comes from aggregator and press coverage and the 2022 amount is undisclosed. YourStory piece on the founders returned 403.
